verdict.rationale: pnpm documents CI-specific behavior directly relevant to fast, reproducible installs: automatic frozen-lockfile mode in CI, a content-addressable global store with hard-linking to avoid re-downloading/re-installing identical packages, an offline flag that forces use of only locally cached packages, and a self-contained CI-friendly executable with runtime pinning. Community benchmarks corroborate real CI speed gains. missing for 10: a dedicated 'CI cache-restore setup' guide/example (e.g. GitHub Actions cache-key snippet for the pnpm store) and independent verification of offline-mode reliability at scale.
